info.title: specgen
info.description: AI-powered functional specification generator for Microsoft Dataverse solutions. Parses plugins, workflows, custom APIs, and more to produce structured Markdown documentation.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: specgen — Generate functional specifications from Dataverse solution components using AI.

commands.name: generate
commands.description:
Generate functional specification documents using AI.

Environment variables:
  OPENAI_API_KEY     OpenAI / Azure OpenAI API key
  OPENAI_ENDPOINT      Azure OpenAI endpoint URL
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY   Anthropic API key

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to the unpacked solution folder

options.name: --plugins
options.description: Path(s) to plugin project folder(s)

options.name: --scripts
options.description: Path to the web resources / scripts folder

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for generated spec files

options.name: --component
options.description: Component type to generate: plugins, scripts, tables, roles, forms, views, workflows, custom-apis, env-vars, convert-rules, canvas-apps, app-modules, templates, ribbon, all

options.name: --entity
options.description: Filter to a specific entity name

options.name: --provider
options.description: AI provider: openai, azure, anthropic

options.name: --model
options.description: AI model to use (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-20250514)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key for the AI provider (or set via environment variable)

options.name: --prompt-template
options.description: Path to a custom prompt template file

options.name: --example
options.description: Path to an example output file for style reference

options.name: --instructions
options.description: Additional instructions to include in the prompt

options.name: --instructions-file
options.description: Path to a file containing additional instructions

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Maximum tokens for AI response

options.name: --max-parallel
options.description: Maximum parallel AI calls (1 = sequential)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Parse components and show what would be generated without calling AI

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt before AI calls

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress interactive output for pipeline use

options.name: --summary-file
options.description: Path to write a JSON summary of the generation run (includes per-component status and token counts)

options.name: --fail-on-error
options.description: Return exit code 1 if any component fails AI generation

options.name: --skip-existing
options.description: Skip components that already have output .md files (matched by path)

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing non-empty output directory without prompting

commands.name: config
commands.description:
Manage specgen configuration.

Config file: ~/.specgen/config.json
Supported keys: api-key, model, default-output, default-solution, openai-api-key, anthropic-api-key, azure-endpoint, default-provider
